SELECT a.Abbreviation, a.Country
FROM airlines a
JOIN (
    SELECT Airline, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY Airline
) f ON a.uid = f.Airline
WHERE f.flight_count = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT Airline, COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY Airline
    )
);

        FROM flights
        GROUP BY Airline
    )
